requirements.text: A launch configuration has a type.
A string attribute has a string value.
A boolean attribute has a boolean value.
A map attribute is a class.
A map entry is a class.
A list attribute is a class.
A list entry has a string value.
A launch configuration has zero or more attributes.
A map attribute has zero or more map entries.
A map entry is connected to one map attribute.
A list attribute has zero or more list entries.
A list entry is connected to one list attribute.
